name: Follow the line
title: What's on your mind this morning?
note: Follow the line carousel posted; all verses checked
caption:
Follow your line, then tell us where it landed.

Whatever is on your mind this morning, your work, your family, your bills or tomorrow, you can hand it to God before the day gets going. He is the one who builds, provides and carries what you cannot.

Proverbs 16:3, Matthew 6:34, Psalm 127:1, Philippians 4:19 (BSB)
